name: Main (baseline)
mechanism: Fanout ⌈ln n+3⌉ anti-entropy rounds with peer frontier and repair lane, as on main.

name: Flat forward-once
mechanism: Send each change once, newest first, to ⌈ln n+3⌉ peers; receivers forward once (PR #108).

name: GossipSub v1.1
mechanism: Degree-D mesh push with IHAVE/IWANT gossip to non-mesh peers (scoring omitted).

name: Plumtree
mechanism: Per-origin epidemic broadcast trees: eager push on the tree, lazy IHAVE/GRAFT repair.

name: Thicket
mechanism: Several Plumtree-style trees; each node is interior in at most one.

name: Snow
mechanism: Balanced k-ary tree per root over the sorted membership ring.

name: Direct mail + acks
mechanism: Origin sends its own changes to every peer; per-peer cumulative acks drive retransmit.

name: Bimodal Multicast
mechanism: Unacked direct mail to every peer plus periodic digest anti-entropy repair.

name: AZ hierarchy
mechanism: Direct mail within the zone; one rendezvous gateway per other zone relays.

name: Scuttlebutt
mechanism: Push-pull reconciliation of per-origin version digests with random peers.

name: Owner aggregation
mechanism: Each key's rendezvous-hash owner aggregates hits and broadcasts the total.

name: Local only (reference)
mechanism: No dissemination at all: each pod admits on its own counts. The floor for bytes, the ceiling for error.
